Use the original rubric and make a fresh judgment. This transport encodes quote ownership
once per row. List the row's distinct eligible citation_ids in the order chosen by you. Return
one quote_checks entry in that same order for each ID. Each entry's quote marker selects the whole
unchanged owning excerpt. If you use two sentences from the same citation, return only one ID
and a single check explaining their relevance. Empty citation_ids requires empty quote_checks.
Return eligible finding/claim links only. Each required finding, reference fact and condition
ID must occur exactly once at its required level, and use valid zero-based claim indexes.
For a decisive row supported by exactly one quote, your explicit row label and that quote's
explicit label must agree. Decide which labels are justified by reading the hypothesis and
excerpt. Change either if necessary; unrelated or incomplete evidence can be NEUTRAL.
Every semantic label, applicability decision, chosen citation and reason is yours.
Before submission check ID uniqueness, ownership, completeness and label consistency.

abstention.label: JUSTIFIED
abstention.reason: The question asks for a specific promise that applicant goals for minority, women, and service-disabled veteran utilization are expected to meet or exceed New York State’s 30% MWBE goal. The retrieved passages only show acknowledgment of ESD’s agency-wide 30% MWBE and 6% SDVOB goals and state that any project-specific goal may be higher or lower than those figures and is subject to good-faith efforts if funded, so they do not document the exact promised expectation in the question.
